```{r load packages and data, include=FALSE}
library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(ashr)
library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(GOstats)

counts <- read.table("data/exp2.counts", header = TRUE)
counts <- as.data.frame(counts)

gene_info <- counts[, 1:6]
counts <- counts[, 7:29]
counts$Geneid <- gene_info$Geneid
rownames(counts) <- counts$Geneid
counts <- subset(counts, select = -Geneid)
metadata <- read.csv("data/metadata_virus.csv")



```

```{r read counts, include=FALSE}

total_counts <- colSums(counts[, -1])


```

```{r DESeq object, include= FALSE}


# filter counts; genes with zero expression in every sample excluded
filtered_counts <- counts[rowSums(counts) > 0, ]

filtered_counts <- as.matrix(filtered_counts)

# 'filtered_counts_matrix' will now contain genes with non-zero counts in at least one sample

# add a small pseudocount to the counts, because rlog/vst does not work for 0 
pseudocount <- 1 # adjust as needed
counts_with_pseudocount <- filtered_counts + pseudocount

# copy the columns 1:3 and 19:23 to a new matrix
counts_with_pseudocount_24_A2 <- counts_with_pseudocount[, c(1:3, 19:23)]
counts_with_pseudocount_48_A2 <- counts_with_pseudocount[, c(4:6, 19:23)]
counts_with_pseudocount_72_A2 <- counts_with_pseudocount[, c(7:9, 19:23)]
counts_with_pseudocount_24_B3 <- counts_with_pseudocount[, c(10:12, 19:23)]
counts_with_pseudocount_48_B3 <- counts_with_pseudocount[, c(13:15, 19:23)]
counts_with_pseudocount_72_B3 <- counts_with_pseudocount[, c(16:18, 19:23)]
counts_with_pseudocounts_IFNB <- counts_with_pseudocount[, c(19:23)]

# do same for metadata
metadata_24_A2 <- metadata[c(1:3, 19:23), ]
metadata_48_A2 <- metadata[c(4:6, 19:23), ]
metadata_72_A2 <- metadata[c(7:9, 19:23), ]
metadata_24_B3 <- metadata[c(10:12, 19:23), ]
metadata_48_B3 <- metadata[c(13:15, 19:23), ]
metadata_72_B3 <- metadata[c(16:18, 19:23), ]
metadata_INFB <- metadata[c(19:23), ]

# create a list with the datasets and metadata
datasets <- list(counts_with_pseudocount_24_A2, 
                 counts_with_pseudocount_48_A2, 
                 counts_with_pseudocount_72_A2, 
                 counts_with_pseudocount_24_B3, 
                 counts_with_pseudocount_48_B3, 
                 counts_with_pseudocount_72_B3,
                 counts_with_pseudocounts_IFNB)
metadata_list <- list(metadata_24_A2, 
                      metadata_48_A2, 
                      metadata_72_A2, 
                      metadata_24_B3, 
                      metadata_48_B3, 
                      metadata_72_B3, 
                      metadata_INFB)
# add names to the list
names(datasets) <- c("Condition_A2_Time_24", "Condition_A2_Time_48", "Condition_A2_Time_72", "Condition_B3_Time_24", "Condition_B3_Time_48", "Condition_B3_Time_72", "Condition_IFNB")

# loop through the list and create a deseqdataset for each dataset
for (i in 1:length(datasets)) {
  datasets[[i]] <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = datasets[[i]],
                              colData = metadata_list[[i]],
                              design = ~ condition)
}

# differential gene expression analysis for each dataset
for (i in 1:length(datasets)) {
  datasets[[i]] <- DESeq(datasets[[i]])
}
```


```{r DGE analysis summary, include=FALSE}
# calculate the results for each dataset
results_list <- list()
for (i in 1:length(datasets)) {
  results_list[[i]] <- results(datasets[[i]])
}
# add names
names(results_list) <- c("Condition_A2_Time_24", "Condition_A2_Time_48", "Condition_A2_Time_72", "Condition_B3_Time_24", "Condition_B3_Time_48", "Condition_B3_Time_72", "Condition_IFNB")
```

For the INFB condition, differential expression analysis results are plotted below. The plot shows the log2FoldChange vs baseMean for each gene. The genes that are most upregulated in the INFB condition are labelled. The genes are also colored in a scale for p-value. 
```{r logFC vs base mean, echo=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=7, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# load data

results <- results_list$Condition_IFNB
results <- as.data.frame(results)
results$gene_id <- rownames(results)

# Specify genes to label
genes_to_label <- c("OAS1", "OAS3", "IFITM1", "ISG15", rownames(head(results[order(results$log2FoldChange),], 5)))

# Create the plot
p <- ggplot(results) +
  geom_point(aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = log2(baseMean), color = results$padj), size = 1) +
  labs(x = "log2FoldChange", y = "baseMean") + 
  labs(color = "Adjusted p-value: ") + 
  ggtitle("log2FoldChange vs baseMean in mock vs INFB") +
  theme(
    legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),  
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"),  
    legend.text = element_text(size = 4),  
    legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)  # Adjust the caption position
  ) 


# Add labels for specific genes
p <- p + geom_text_repel(data = results[results$gene_id %in% genes_to_label, ],
                         aes(x = log2FoldChange,
                             y = log2(baseMean),
                             label = gene_id),
                         box.padding = 0.5,
                         force = 1,
                         segment.color = "green",
                         segment.size = 0.2)
print(p)

```

To visualize the gene expression of significant genes over time in the A2 infected cells, a heatmap is shown below. here, red shows upregulation and blue shows downregulation. The genes are clustered by hierarchical clustering.

```{r heatmap A2, echo=FALSE, fig.width=5, fig.height=7}
# load data
results_A2 <- results_list$Condition_A2_Time_24
results_A2_1 <- results_list$Condition_A2_Time_48
results_A2_2 <- results_list$Condition_A2_Time_72

results_A2 <- results_A2[!is.na(results_A2$padj) &
                               results_A2$padj < 0.01 &
                               (results_A2$log2FoldChange < -1.5 |
                               results_A2$log2FoldChange > 1.5), ]
results_A2 <- as.data.frame(results_A2)

results_A2_1 <- results_A2_1[!is.na(results_A2_1$padj) &
                               results_A2_1$padj < 0.01 &
                               (results_A2_1$log2FoldChange < -1.5 |
                               results_A2_1$log2FoldChange > 1.5), ]
results_A2_1 <- as.data.frame(results_A2_1)

results_A2_2 <- results_A2_2[!is.na(results_A2_2$padj) &
                               results_A2_2$padj < 0.01 &
                               (results_A2_2$log2FoldChange < -1.5 |
                               results_A2_2$log2FoldChange > 1.5), ]
results_A2_2 <- as.data.frame(results_A2_2)

# find the shared genes in the three timepoints
x <- rownames(results_A2)
y <- rownames(results_A2_1)
z <- rownames(results_A2_2)

shared_genes_A2 <- intersect(x, y)
shared_genes_A2 <- intersect(shared_genes_A2, z)
shared_genes_A2 <- as.data.frame(shared_genes_A2)

unique_genes_A2 <- c(x, y, z)
unique_genes_A2 <- as.data.frame(unique_genes_A2) %>% unique()


# extract counts from deseq datasets
counts_A2_24 <- counts(datasets$Condition_A2_Time_24, normalized = TRUE)
counts_A2_48 <- counts(datasets$Condition_A2_Time_48, normalized = TRUE)
counts_A2_72 <- counts(datasets$Condition_A2_Time_72, normalized = TRUE)

# calculate mean for mock and A3
mock <- rowMeans(counts_A2_24[, 6:8])
mock <- as.data.frame(mock)
colnames(mock) <- "mock"

A2_24 <- rowMeans(counts_A2_24[, 1:3])
A2_24 <- as.data.frame(A2_24)
colnames(A2_24) <- "24"

A2_48 <- rowMeans(counts_A2_48[, 1:3])
A2_48 <- as.data.frame(A2_48)
colnames(A2_48) <- "48"

A2_72 <- rowMeans(counts_A2_72[, 1:3])
A2_72 <- as.data.frame(A2_72)
colnames(A2_72) <- "72"

# create table with genes as rows, mean counts as cols: mock, 24, 48, 72
unique_genes_A2$mock <- mock$mock[match(unique_genes_A2$unique_genes_A2,
                                                          rownames(A2_24))]
unique_genes_A2$"24h" <- A2_24$"24"[match(unique_genes_A2$unique_genes_A2,
                                                          rownames(A2_24))]
unique_genes_A2$"48h" <- A2_48$"48"[match(unique_genes_A2$unique_genes_A2,
                                                          rownames(A2_48))]
unique_genes_A2$"72h" <- A2_72$"72"[match(unique_genes_A2$unique_genes_A2,
                                                          rownames(A2_72))]

rownames(unique_genes_A2) <- unique_genes_A2$unique_genes_A2

pheatmap_A2 <- pheatmap(unique_genes_A2[, 2:5], 
                        scale = "row", 
                        show_rownames = FALSE, 
                        cluster_rows = TRUE, 
                        cluster_cols = FALSE, 
                        fontsize = 5,
                        main = "Heatmap for gene expression as a function of time in A2 virus infected neurons")


```

```{r clusters A2, echo=FALSE, fig.width=4, fig.height=3}

#extract clusters 
clusters_A2 <- cbind(unique_genes_A2[, 2:5],
                     cluster = cutree(pheatmap_A2$tree_row,
                                      k = 9))

clusters_A2_list <- list()

# find genes in each cluster with a loop
for (i in 1:9) {
  assign(paste0("cluster_A2_", i), clusters_A2[clusters_A2$cluster == i, ])
  clusters_A2_list[[i]] <- get(paste0("cluster_A2_", i))
}




```

From the previous heatmap, 9 clusters were extracted. The following graphs show the relative gene expression for each cluster as a function of time. 

```{r clustergraphs A2, echo=FALSE, fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
# Create a list to store the long-format data frames
long_format_clusters <- list()

# Loop through each cluster
for (i in 1:length(clusters_A2_list)) {
  # Subset the data for the current cluster
  current_cluster <- get(paste0("cluster_A2_", i))
  current_cluster <- as.data.frame(current_cluster)

  # Calculate the mean expression for the current cluster
  cluster_mean <- rowMeans(current_cluster[, 1:4])
  cluster_stdev <- apply(current_cluster[, 1:4], 1, sd)

  # Calculate relative gene expression by subtracting the cluster mean
  current_cluster[, 1:4] <- (current_cluster[, 1:4] - cluster_mean) / cluster_stdev
  current_cluster[, 1:4] <- sapply(current_cluster[, 1:4], 
                                   function(x) ifelse(x < -3, -3, 
                                                      ifelse(x > 3, 3, x)))

  # Convert the current cluster to long format
  current_cluster_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(current_cluster, 
    cols = c("mock", "24h", "48h", "72h"),
    names_to = "timepoint", values_to = "relative_expression"
  )
  
  # Add a column to store gene names
  current_cluster_long$gene <- rep(rownames(current_cluster), each = 4) # Repeat each gene name for the 4 timepoints
  
  # Reorder the levels of the "timepoint" factor to have "mock" first
  current_cluster_long$timepoint <- factor(current_cluster_long$timepoint, levels = c("mock", "24h", "48h", "72h"))

  # Create a ggplot for the current cluster
  plot <- ggplot(current_cluster_long, aes(x = timepoint,
                                           y = relative_expression,
                                           group = gene,
                                           color = gene)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = paste0("Cluster ", i)) +
    labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "z-score") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  # Show the plot
  print(plot)
}


```


For every cluster, GO term enrichment analysis is performed and visualized in the graphs below. 
```{r GO term enrichment A2, include=FALSE}

# create object with all the gene names in dataset for universe
all_genes <- rownames(counts)
all_genes <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, ## convert gene ids to Entrez IDs
                    keys = all_genes, 
                    column = "ENTREZID", 
                    keytype = "SYMBOL")

# create list to store go term analysis results
goterm_results_A2 <- list()

# go term enrichment analysis for every cluster in the cluster list
for (i in 1:length(clusters_A2_list)) {
  # object with names of all significant genes
  sign_genes_A2 <- rownames(clusters_A2_list[[i]])
  
  # convert gene IDs to Entrez IDs
  sign_genes_A2 <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, 
                          keys = sign_genes_A2,
                          column = "ENTREZID", 
                          keytype = "SYMBOL")
  

  # Perform GO term enrichment analysis
  test_object_A2 <- new("GOHyperGParams",
                        geneIds = sign_genes_A2,
                        universeGeneIds = all_genes, 
                        annotation = "org.Hs.eg.db", 
                        ontology = "BP", 
                        pvalueCutoff = 1,
                        testDirection = "over")
  
  # save current results in the list
  goterm_results_A2[[i]] <- hyperGTest(test_object_A2)
  }

```

From the previous heatmap, 9 clusters were extracted. The following graphs show the relative gene expression for each cluster as a function of time. 

```{r clustergraphs merged, echo=FALSE, fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
# Create a list to store the long-format data frames
long_format_clusters <- list()

# Loop through each cluster
for (i in 1:5) {
  # Subset the data for the current cluster
  current_cluster <- get(paste0("cluster_", i))
  current_cluster <- as.data.frame(current_cluster)

  # Calculate the mean expression for the current cluster
  cluster_mean_A2 <- rowMeans(current_cluster[, 1:4])
  cluster_stdev_A2 <- apply(current_cluster[, 1:4], 1, sd)
  
  current_cluster_A2 <- current_cluster[, 1:4]

  # Calculate relative gene expression by subtracting the cluster mean
  current_cluster_A2 <- (current_cluster_A2 - cluster_mean_A2) / cluster_stdev_A2
  #current_cluster_A2 <- sapply(current_cluster_A2, 
                                   #function(x) ifelse(x < -3, -3, 
                                                      #ifelse(x > 3, 3, x)))
  
  colnames(current_cluster_A2) <- c("mock", "24h", "48h", "72h")

  # Convert the current cluster to long format
  current_cluster_long_A2 <- tidyr::pivot_longer(current_cluster_A2, 
    cols = c("mock", "24h", "48h", "72h"),
    names_to = "timepoint", values_to = "relative_expression"
  )
  
  # Add a column to store gene names
  current_cluster_long_A2$gene <- rep(rownames(current_cluster_A2), each = 4) # Repeat each gene name for the 4 timepoints
  
  # Reorder the levels of the "timepoint" factor to have "mock" first
  current_cluster_long_A2$timepoint <- factor(current_cluster_long_A2$timepoint, levels = c("mock", "24h", "48h", "72h"))

  # Create a ggplot for the current cluster
  plot_A2 <- ggplot(current_cluster_long_A2, aes(x = timepoint,
                                           y = relative_expression,
                                           group = gene,
                                           color = gene)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = paste0("A2 Cluster ", i)) +
    labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "z-score") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  # Show the plot
  print(plot_A2)
  
  cluster_mean_B3 <- rowMeans(current_cluster[, 5:8])
  cluster_stdev_B3 <- apply(current_cluster[, 5:8], 1, sd)
  
  current_cluster_B3 <- current_cluster[, 5:8]
  
  # Calculate relative gene expression by subtracting the cluster mean
  current_cluster_B3 <- (current_cluster_B3 - cluster_mean_B3) / cluster_stdev_B3
  #current_cluster_B3 <- sapply(current_cluster_B3, 
                                   #function(x) ifelse(x < -3, -3, 
                                                     # ifelse(x > 3, 3, x)))
  
  colnames(current_cluster_B3) <- c("mock", "24h", "48h", "72h")
  
  # Convert the current cluster to long format
  current_cluster_long_B3 <- tidyr::pivot_longer(current_cluster_B3, 
    cols = c("mock", "24h", "48h", "72h"),
    names_to = "timepoint", values_to = "relative_expression"
  )
  
  # Add a column to store gene names
  current_cluster_long_B3$gene <- rep(rownames(current_cluster_B3), each = 4) # Repeat each gene name for the 4 timepoints
  
  # Reorder the levels of the "timepoint" factor to have "mock" first
  current_cluster_long_B3$timepoint <- factor(current_cluster_long_B3$timepoint, levels = c("mock", "24h", "48h", "72h"))
  
  # Create a ggplot for the current cluster
  plot_B3 <- ggplot(current_cluster_long_B3, aes(x = timepoint,
                                              y = relative_expression,
                                              group = gene,
                                              color = gene)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = paste0("B3 Cluster ", i)) +
    labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "z-score") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  # Show the plot
  print(plot_B3)
}


```

```{r visual goterms graphs, echo=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}

visualize_GO_enrichment <- function(goterm_results, title_prefix, save_path = NULL) {
  summary <- summary(goterm_results)
  summary <- summary %>% filter(Count > 5) %>% filter(Count < 500)
  
  summary$padj <- p.adjust(summary$Pvalue, method = "BH")
  
  # Select the top 20 GO terms
  goterm_top20 <- summary[order(summary$padj)[1:20],]

  # Plot the p-values of the top 20 GO terms
  goterm_top20$Term <- factor(goterm_top20$Term, 
                              levels = goterm_top20$Term[order(goterm_top20$padj, decreasing = TRUE)])
  
  # Plot the visualization
  plot_obj <- ggplot(goterm_top20, aes(x = Term, y = -log10(padj))) +
    geom_point() +
    coord_flip() +
    ylab(expression(-log[10](adjusted~italic(P)~value))) + 
    ggtitle(title_prefix) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 4),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 4, face = "bold"))

  # Display the plot
  print(plot_obj)

  # Save the plot if a save path is provided
  #if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    #ggsave(file.path("data/plots/", save_path), plot_obj, width = 12, height = 6)
 # }
}

# Visualize results for each cluster in WT
for (i in seq_along(goterm_results)) {
  visualize_GO_enrichment(goterm_results[[i]], paste("GO terms Cluster", i))#,
                          #save_path = paste("GOterms_Cluster_", i, ".png", sep = ""))
}
```
